$comment: Skill content vendored into Orbit. The source is galaxyproject/agentic-plugins, which mirrors galaxy-skills and the Foundry casts at pins of its own; the pin recorded here is a commit because tags are mutable, and `tag` is a label that stays null while the pinned commit is ahead of the newest tag upstream. Regenerate with `npm run sync:skills`; verify with `npm run check:skills`. Do not hand-edit files under extensions/orbit/vendor/skills/. `as` is the prefix each plugin's content is written under, relative to its `skills/` root, chosen so a bundled path is the same string as the path a live fetch would use. `repo` names the configured skills repo a plugin backs, and `router: "catalog"` puts its SKILL.md frontmatter into _catalog.json; `never` keeps a plugin out of the system prompt entirely. A plugin with `"source": "local"` reads `dir` in this repo instead of agentic-plugins: Orbit's staging skills, temporary residents that each name a proposed_home and move there. An exclude is content Orbit has no use for, such as a cast's feedback ledger, which belongs to a review loop Orbit does not run.

plugins.why: Using and building Galaxy: collection manipulation, the MCP tool surface, user-defined tools, workflow reports, reproducibility.
Workflow construction cast bundles: finding and reading a community workflow, adapting one through the update-interview phases, and triaging a run that failed.
Skills Orbit writes and tests itself before they move to agentic-plugins.
